title: Minkowski spacetime baseline in Cartesian coordinates

coordinate_system.name: Cartesian inertial coordinates
coordinate_system.description: A four-dimensional coordinate chart using naturalized units with c = 1.

assumptions: Metric components are constant in the declared Cartesian inertial coordinates.
The cosmological constant is zero for this baseline profile.
The candidate is a software and reproducibility benchmark, not a transportation proposal.

claims.statement: The submitted matrix is an exact machine-readable representation of the selected Minkowski baseline under the declared conventions.

falsification: Reject the baseline result if the matrix is not 4 by 4, symmetric, non-degenerate, or equal to diag(-1, 1, 1, 1) under the declared profile.
Reject the analytic flatness implication if any metric component depends on a coordinate in this profile.
Downgrade reproducibility if an independent implementation does not recover the same scientific payload digest from the same candidate and validator version.
